title: Blackwood Den
wikitext:
[[Image:Blackwood Den.jpg|thumb|Blackwood Den]]

'''Blackwood Den''' is located in the far southern area of [[Darkshore]], near the border with [[Ashenvale]]. It is comprised of a few [[corrupted furbolg]] [[camp]]s and a small cave. Inside the cave sits a lone [[night elf]] named [[Volcor]] who awaits rescue. Talking to someone in [[Auberdine]] may be prudent to get the item needed to help Volcor out of his predicament.
